# NLP501-bench v1 results (generated by `python -m app.eval.benchmark report`; do not edit by hand)

Protocol: docs/BENCHMARK.md. Manifest: data/eval/benchmark_v1.json (all inputs match). Each JD ranks the CVs labelled for it; mean over JDs with a 95% bootstrap CI; paired one-sided bootstrap p for “first > second”. LLM: Claude Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5; PYTHONHASHSEED=0.
